chunks: God will not leave the believers in the state they are in till He has sifted the evil from the good; nor will God reveal the secrets of the Unknown. He chooses (for this) from His apostles whom He will. So believe in God and the prophets, for if you believe and fear the displeasure of God your reward will be great.
ai.seo_question: What is the wisdom behind God's delay in revealing the unseen to the believers?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *Tadrij* (gradualism) in divine revelation, illustrating how the community undergoes a period of testing to distinguish the *Sadiqeen* (truthful) from the *Munafiqeen* (hypocrites). It emphasizes that while general knowledge of the unseen (*Al-Ghayb*) is reserved for the Prophets and Imams, believers are called to active faith and piety (*Taqwa*) as the means to attain spiritual distinction and divine reward.
